dataset.availability: The public archive contains the original UP1 file and author notebook. This example uses the explicitly documented measured-derived 32 x 32 scan crop, prepared separately.
dataset.reproduction_notes: Author-notebook-based import/crop/inspection only. The full paper was unavailable. No NLPAR, Radon transform, pattern-center optimization, indexing, orientations, phase discrimination or paper accuracy/speed result is reproduced.

archive_verification_note: Local intake used checked bounded byte ranges and cross-checked the MDF mirror. Full archive/member checksums were not verified.

files.selection: Original scan columns 0..31 and rows 0..31, in source row-major order; each complete 116 x 116 uint8 detector pattern retained unchanged.
files.transformation: Copy original 42-byte version 3 header and change only row/column counts to 32. Preserve every selected detector byte, header flags and scan steps. No contrast processing, noise injection, interpolation, indexing or frame rotation.

package_status: Not included in normal DREAM3D-NX packages. Dataset/pipeline approval and final packaging are pending.

paper_expansion.status: Deferred until full-text access and method/capability review.
